copy_leakage.description: User-facing copy leaks spec, review, methodology, or checklist language.

mixed_visual_dialect.description: The first viewport mixes multiple competing visual dialects without one governing direction.

blank_primary_stage.description: The primary stage is dominated by empty, decorative, or low-information regions instead of the real task.

offscreen_primary_task.description: The primary task starts outside the common first viewport or requires scrolling before use.

summary_first_relapse.description: Users must parse summary/KPI/explainer regions before reaching the main task.

unsupported_primary_cta.description: The primary CTA is not backed by the visible flow, state, or next-step handoff.

visual_weight_collision.description: Multiple heavy regions compete for first attention and break the reading path.

trust_posture_mismatch.description: A high-trust home surface feels like a generic analytics dashboard instead of calm/control/trust.

hero_dominance_over_task.description: Hero copy, slogan, or decorative surfaces dominate the screen more than the primary functional area.

over_decorated_surface.description: Decorative effects exist without hierarchy or state value.

repeated_supporting_content.description: Supporting content is repeated across multiple surfaces.

generic_microcopy.description: CTA, helper, or error copy remains too generic.
